metadata.title: Error codes — Nebula
metadata.description: What each error code means and what to try.

page.paragraph_2: What each error code means and what to try.

codes.paragraph_1: No matching codes. Try another word or use the bug report guide.
codes.meaning_1: The game’s code crashed with no mods in use.
codes.try_1: Start again. If it repeats at the same place, report it with the report files.
codes.meaning_2: The game stopped on one of its own checks. The report quotes its message.
codes.try_2: Start again. If it repeats at the same place, report it with the report files.
codes.meaning_3: The game’s code ran out of stack space.
codes.try_3: Start again. If it repeats at the same place, report it with the report files.
codes.meaning_4: The game crashed while mods were in use. The report lists them.
codes.try_4: Turn the mods off. If the crash stops, turn them on one at a time.
codes.meaning_5: The game crashed within 15 seconds of reading a mod’s file. The report names the mod and the file.
codes.try_5: Turn that mod off, or check that it matches your game’s region and version.
codes.meaning_6: The game crashed in a mod’s code. The report names the mod. Windows only.
codes.try_6: Turn that mod off and send its author the report files.
codes.meaning_7: A texture pack image stopped Nebula while loading. The report names the file.
codes.try_7: Remove the image from the pack, or save it again as a PNG.
codes.meaning_8: A replacement movie stopped Nebula while playing. The report names the file.
codes.try_8: Remove the video, or convert it to an H.264 MP4.
codes.meaning_9: The graphics driver reset the graphics card.
codes.try_9: Update the graphics driver. Turn off ray tracing or frame generation, or lower the internal resolution.
codes.meaning_10: The renderer stopped on another error. The report quotes it.
codes.try_10: Update the graphics driver. If it repeats, report it.
codes.try_11: Close other programs, set Texture packs to On instead of Preload, or lower the internal resolution.
codes.try_12: Start again. If it repeats, report it.
codes.meaning_13: Nebula stopped on an unexpected error. The report quotes it.
codes.try_13: Start again. If it repeats, report it.
codes.try_14: Start again. If it repeats, report it.
codes.meaning_15: Nebula stopped on an internal error while starting.
codes.try_15: Start again. If it repeats, report it.
codes.meaning_16: Nebula could not open the game content (game.pak).
codes.try_16: Open Nebula Setup and choose Repair.
codes.try_17: Run Nebula Setup again to rebuild it from your disc image.
codes.meaning_18: The game module is missing or from another Nebula version.
codes.meaning_19: The graphics card could not start the game.
codes.try_19: Update the graphics driver. With two graphics cards, choose the other one under Graphics card on the SYSTEM page.
codes.meaning_20: Nebula could not read its settings file.
codes.try_20: Rename config.ini in Nebula’s settings folder to start with default settings.
codes.meaning_21: Nebula was started with unknown arguments.
codes.try_21: Start Nebula from its shortcut or app menu entry.

report.paragraph_1: Attach the newest .txt and .dmp files from Nebula’s crashes folder, with the steps that caused the problem.
